Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element

  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Built **ONE—ROUND: Hell on Pickup**, a playable 3D first-person arena shooter with a single recoverable bullet, four approaching demons, health, and a foundry arena.

- Desktop: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, E to pick up the round.
- Phone/tablet: virtual joystick to move, drag to aim, and on-screen fire/pickup buttons.
- Includes sound toggle, damage feedback, win/lose screens, and replay.

**Assumption:** I treated the attachment as visual inspiration and made an original industrial foundry arena. The game uses Three.js from a CDN, so it needs an internet connection to load.

Verified the game renders and checked the mobile layout in-browser.
